<div class="container section-title-container" ><h1 class="section-title section-title-normal"><b aria-hidden="true"></b><span class="section-title-main" >Privacy Policy</span><b aria-hidden="true"></b></h1></div>
<p>This website is owned and operated by Unique Cash for Cars and will be referred to as “We”, “our” and “us” in this Internet Privacy Policy. By using this site, you agree to the Internet Privacy Policy of this website (“https://uniquecashforcars.com.au/”), which is set out on this website page. The Internet Privacy Policy relates to the collection and use of personal information you may supply to us through your conduct on the website.</p>
<p>We reserve the right, at our discretion, to modify or remove portions of this Internet Privacy Policy at any time. This Internet Privacy Policy is in addition to any other terms and conditions applicable to the website. We do not make any representations about third party websites that may be linked to the website.</p>
<p>We recognise the importance of protecting the privacy of information collected about visitors to our website, in particular, information that is capable of identifying an individual (“personal information”). This Internet Privacy Policy governs the manner in which your personal information, obtained through the website, will be dealt with. This Internet Privacy Policy should be reviewed periodically so that you are updated on any changes. We welcome your comments and feedback.</p>
<p>The brand names, trademarks or any other Proprietary designations of motor vehicles are only used for reference purposes on these web pages. No affiliation exists between Unique Cash for Cars and any of the brand manufacturers.</p>
<h4>Personal Information</h4>
<p>Personal information about visitors to our site is collected only when knowingly and voluntarily submitted. For example, we may need to collect such information to provide you with further services or to answer or forward any requests or enquiries. It is our intention that this policy will protect your personal information from being dealt with in any way that is inconsistent with applicable privacy laws in Australia.</p>
<h4>Use Of Information</h4>
<p>Personal information that visitors submit to our site is used only for the purpose for which it is submitted or for such other secondary purposes that are related to the primary purpose unless we disclose other uses in this Internet Privacy Policy or at the time of collection. Copies of correspondence sent from the website, that may contain personal information, are stored as archives for record-keeping and backup purposes only.</p>
<h4>Disclosure</h4>
<p>Apart from where you have consented or disclosure is necessary to achieve the purpose for which it was submitted, personal information may be disclosed in special situations where we have reason to believe that doing so is necessary to identify, contact or bring legal action against anyone damaging, injuring, or interfering (intentionally or unintentionally) with our rights or property, users, or anyone else who could be harmed by such activities. Also, we may disclose personal information when we believe in good faith that the law requires disclosure. We may engage third parties to provide you with goods or services on our behalf. In that circumstance, we may disclose your personal information to those third parties in order to meet your request for goods or services.</p>
<h4>Security</h4>
<p>We strive to ensure the security, integrity and privacy of personal information submitted to our sites, and we review and update our security measures in light of current technologies. Unfortunately, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be totally secure. However, we will endeavour to take all reasonable steps to protect the personal information you may transmit to us or from our online products and services. Once we do receive your transmission, we will also make our best efforts to ensure its security on our systems. In addition, our employees and the contractors who provide services related to our information systems are obliged to respect the confidentiality of any personal information held by us. However, we will not be held responsible for events arising from unauthorised access to your personal information.</p>
<h4>Cookies</h4>
<p>Cookies are data that a Web site transfers to an individual’s hard drive for record-keeping purposes. Cookies, which are industry standard and are used by most Web sites, including those operated by us, can facilitate a user’s ongoing access to and use of a site. They allow us to customise the website to your needs. If you do not want information collected through the use of Cookies, there is a simple procedure in most browsers that allow you to deny or accept the Cookie feature. But you should note that Cookies may be necessary to provide you with some features of our on-line services.</p>
<h4>Access To Information</h4>
<p>We will endeavour to take all reasonable steps to keep secure any information which we hold about you and to keep this information accurate and up to date. If, at any time, you discover that information held about you is incorrect, you may contact us to have the information corrected. In addition, our employees and the contractors who provide services related to our information systems are obliged to respect the confidentiality of any personal information held by us.</p>
<h4>Links To Other Sites</h4>
<p>We provide links to Web sites outside of our websites, as well as to third-party Web sites. These linked sites are not under our control, and we cannot accept responsibility for the conduct of companies linked to our website. Before disclosing your personal information on any other website, we advise you to examine the terms and conditions of using that Web site and its privacy statement.</p>
<h4>Problems Or Questions</h4>
<p>If we become aware of any ongoing concerns or problems with our websites, we will take these issues seriously and work to address these concerns. If you have any further queries relating to our Privacy Policy, or you have a problem or complaint, please contact us. Further Privacy Information. <div class="entry-meta uppercase is-xsmall">
<span class="posted-on">Posted on <a href="https://uniquecashforcars.com.au/5-best-luxury-eco-friendly-cars-in-australia-2020/" rel="bookmark"><time class="entry-date published" datetime="2020-09-22T13:04:41+10:00">September 22, 2020</time><time class="updated" datetime="2022-05-18T14:17:27+10:00">May 18, 2022</time></a></span> <span class="byline">by <span class="meta-author vcard"><a class="url fn n" href="https://uniquecashforcars.com.au/author/uniquecashforcars/">uniquecashforcars</a></span></span>	</div>

<div class="entry-content single-page">
<p>When planning to buy a new car you should know that “Green is the new Black” in terms of <strong>luxury cars in Australia</strong>. Electric car sales have been growing at an astounding rate over the past few years and it’s predicted to grow even more. There are two types of eco-friendly cars fully electric vehicles (EV) and plug-in hybrid vehicles (PHEV) which can be found in the Australian market.</p><div id="ez-toc-container" class="ez-toc-v2_0_85 counter-hierarchy ez-toc-counter ez-toc-white ez-toc-container-direction">
<div class="ez-toc-title-container">
<p class="ez-toc-title" style="cursor:inherit">Contents</p>
<span class="ez-toc-title-toggle"><a href="#" class="ez-toc-pull-right ez-toc-btn ez-toc-btn-xs ez-toc-btn-default ez-toc-toggle" aria-label="Toggle Table of Content"><span class="ez-toc-js-icon-con"><span class=""><span class="eztoc-hide" style="display:none;">Toggle</span><span class="ez-toc-icon-toggle-span"><svg style="fill: #999;color:#999" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="list-377408" width="20px" height="20px" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M6 6H4v2h2V6zm14 0H8v2h12V6zM4 11h2v2H4v-2zm16 0H8v2h12v-2zM4 16h2v2H4v-2zm16 0H8v2h12v-2z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg><svg style="fill: #999;color:#999" class="arrow-unsorted-368013" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10px" height="10px" viewBox="0 0 24 24" version="1.2" baseProfile="tiny"><path d="M18.2 9.3l-6.2-6.3-6.2 6.3c-.2.2-.3.4-.3.7s.1.5.3.7c.2.2.4.3.7.3h11c.3 0 .5-.1.7-.3.2-.2.3-.5.3-.7s-.1-.5-.3-.7zM5.8 14.7l6.2 6.3 6.2-6.3c.2-.2.3-.5.3-.7s-.1-.5-.3-.7c-.2-.2-.4-.3-.7-.3h-11c-.3 0-.5.1-.7.3-.2.2-.3.5-.3.7s.1.5.3.7z"/></svg></span></span></span></a></span></div>
<nav><ul class='ez-toc-list ez-toc-list-level-1 ' ><li class='ez-toc-page-1 ez-toc-heading-level-2'><a class="ez-toc-link ez-toc-heading-1" href="#so_here_are_our_top_5_picks_of_the_best_luxury_cars_electric" >So here are our top 5 picks of the best luxury cars (electric):</a><ul class='ez-toc-list-level-3' ><li class='ez-toc-heading-level-3'><a class="ez-toc-link ez-toc-heading-2" href="#tesla_model_3" >Tesla Model 3</a></li><li class='ez-toc-page-1 ez-toc-heading-level-3'><a class="ez-toc-link ez-toc-heading-3" href="#volvo_s60" >Volvo S60</a></li><li class='ez-toc-page-1 ez-toc-heading-level-3'><a class="ez-toc-link ez-toc-heading-4" href="#jaguar_i-pace" >Jaguar I-Pace</a></li><li class='ez-toc-page-1 ez-toc-heading-level-3'><a class="ez-toc-link ez-toc-heading-5" href="#porsche_panamera_s_e-hybrid" >Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid</a></li><li class='ez-toc-page-1 ez-toc-heading-level-3'><a class="ez-toc-link ez-toc-heading-6" href="#bmw_i8_roadster" >BMW i8 Roadster</a></li></ul></li></ul></nav></div>
<p>Moreover, sales of such cars are further increased after the government relaxed the luxury car tax (LCT) in early 2020. Now that the LCT threshold is increased from $75,526 to $77,565. This has prompted an increase in luxury electric car sales all over the country.</p>
<p> </p>
<h2><span class="ez-toc-section" id="so_here_are_our_top_5_picks_of_the_best_luxury_cars_electric"></span>So here are our top 5 picks of the best luxury cars (electric):<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h2>
<ol>
<li>
<h3><span class="ez-toc-section" id="tesla_model_3"></span>Tesla Model 3<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h3>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Best value luxury car in Australia at the moment. Model 3 is a 4 door 5-seater sedan developed by Elon Musk’s famous brand Tesla. This is the pure electric, long-range, high-performance car. It has a long-range battery installed and has an acceleration time from 0-60 mph in only 3.2 seconds.</p>
<p>Though it has a sporty exterior, its intuitive controls and 15 cubic feet of storage space make it perfect to be used as a family car. It has a minimalistic design. And its battery is located under the floor. This lowers the center of gravity which provides crisp turnings while driving.</p>
<p>Owning a Tesla gives the customer access to a proprietary Supercharger network, which can be found nation-wide. And any improvements and updates will be installed automatically into the car without a hassle.</p>
<p>So if you want to try your hand at the technologically advance self-driving car that is the Model 3; then this car is a very good entry-level car and the least expensive way to try Tesla products.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Price: $66,000</strong></p>
<p><strong>Range: 429 km</strong></p>
<p><strong>Battery: 50kWh</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ol start="2">
<li>
<h3><span class="ez-toc-section" id="volvo_s60"></span>Volvo S60<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h3>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Volvo S60 is one of the best luxury cars in the market. This third-generation Volvo S60 balances high performance and luxury effortlessly in its new more compact design. It is a small luxury car but can seat 5 people with ease. The battery capacity is also increased by the addition of a plug-in battery feature and it can give you 35 km on the all-electric drive.</p>
<p>This hybrid sedan has a sophisticated and spacious interior which looks very high class along with that special care is taken regarding passenger safety by installing a special driver-assistance technology.</p>
<p>This model is loaded with new safety features such as blind-spot monitoring and rear-cross traffic alerts; not only that it also has a reverse automatic emergency brake and steering assists, which makes driving this model a breeze.</p>
<p>Though this luxury sedan is smaller in size compared to other <strong>luxury hybrids in the Australian</strong> market, it was still able to provide 11.6 cubic feet of storage space, which is uncommon for cars this size.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Price: $85,990</strong></p>
<p><strong>Range: 35 km (Only on electric)</strong></p>
<p><strong>Battery: 11.6 kWh</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ol start="3">
<li>
<h3><span class="ez-toc-section" id="jaguar_i-pace"></span>Jaguar I-Pace<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h3>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Jaguar’s I-Pace is the best all-electric <strong>luxury SUV in the market</strong>. This car is for anyone who loves luxury but also prefers having a high performing car. This car can go from 0-60 mph in just over 4 seconds. And it’s one of the quickest and quietest SUVs in the Australian market.</p>
<p>This luxury battery-electric crossover car has a fast charging option and instantaneous acceleration capabilities. With the fast charger, it takes only an hour to charge its lithium-ion battery to 80%, while charging with a level 2 home charger can take about 10 hours to charge.</p>
<p>This model has a cutting-edge design and roomy interior for passenger’s comfort and has 25.3 cubic feet of storage space which can expand to 51 cubic feet when rear seats are folded.</p>
<p>Even though this is a 5-seat sedan it handles more like a sports car. It is a mixture of the comfort of a sedan and the agility of a sports car. Some of its safety features include all-around parking sensors, a rearview camera, and traffic sign recognition, and also high-speed automatic emergency braking.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Price: $124,100</strong></p>
<p><strong>Range: 470 km</strong></p>
<p><strong>Battery: 11 kWh</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ol start="4">
<li>
<h3><span class="ez-toc-section" id="porsche_panamera_s_e-hybrid"></span>Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h3>
</li>
</ol>
<p>It is the most fuel-efficient luxury car in the Porche model range. And the second most expensive car on this list. Panamera is a full-sized super luxury car with a storage space of 17.6 cubic feet and 47.3 cubic feet with rear seats folded. This sized trunk is very uncommon in this class of cars.</p>
<p>It has a front-engine and rear-wheel-drive layout. But it can be found in an all-wheel layout as well. This model has strong engines, comfortable interior with climate control features which is especially useful for Aussie summers.</p>
<p>This hybrid can go from 0-60 mph in under 5.8 seconds. And the battery can be fully charged in 2.5 hours by 240 v powder source. This is a perfect choice for sports car enthusiasts who also want to be eco-friendly.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Price: $280,000</strong></p>
<p><strong>Range: 43 km (Only on electric)</strong></p>
<p><strong>Battery: 9.4 kWh lithium-ion battery</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ol start="5">
<li>
<h3><span class="ez-toc-section" id="bmw_i8_roadster"></span>BMW i8 Roadster<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h3>
</li>
</ol>
<p>BMW i8 Roadster is the most luxurious hybrid sports car in the world. It is a showstopper in luxury cars with its dihedral doors and convertible looks. And the most expensive car on this list.</p>
<p>This plug-in hybrid has an acceleration of 0 – 60 mph in 4.8 seconds but its speed is electronically reduced to be 155 mph. It has a comfortable interior and sleek look but lacks storage space which was found in the other cars on the list.</p>
<p>Its lithium-ion battery on an all-electric model can drive up to 37 km without a recharge. Its battery performance was improved from 7.1 kWh to 11.6 kWh. Which resulted in even better performance.</p>
<p>The BMW i8 Roadster is a show stopper, easy to use, eco-friendly, and fast. It’s all the glam you can ask for with the least damage to the environment.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Price: $348,900</strong></p>
<p><strong>Range:  530 km</strong></p>
<p><strong>Battery: 11.6 kWh Lithium-ion battery</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>So if you are ever in need of replacing a car, wanting to save petrol costs, or simply want to help the planet by reducing your carbon footprint, then these are the <strong>best luxury cars Australia in 2020</strong> to try.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>The above list includes the <strong>best luxury cars in Australia</strong> and all of them are at different price points, so whatever your range is there is something here for everyone. The other benefit of investing in electric or hybrid cars is that the Australian government has reduced the tax threshold thus promoting the use of such vehicles in the country.</p>

<h2><span class="ez-toc-section" id="fixing_a_damaged_car"></span>Fixing a Damaged Car<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h2>
<p>One option when dealing with a damaged car is to have it repaired. However, this decision depends on several factors such as the extent of the damage, the cost of repairs, and the value of your vehicle. If your car has minor dents or scratches from everyday use, fixing it might be a reasonable choice. On the other hand, if your car has been involved in a severe accident or needs extensive repairs that exceed its current value, it may not be financially practical to fix it.</p>
<h2><span class="ez-toc-section" id="costs_and_responsibilities"></span>Costs and Responsibilities<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h2>
<p>Repairing a damaged car can come at a significant cost. Depending on the severity of the damage, you may need to replace body panels, fix mechanical components, or address electrical issues. These repairs can quickly add up and may even surpass your car’s market value. Additionally, keeping up with regular maintenance becomes essential once repairs are done.</p>
<p>Moreover, being responsible for maintaining insurance coverage while having a damaged vehicle can also result in ongoing expenses.</p>
<h2><span class="ez-toc-section" id="is_it_still_safe"></span>Is It Still Safe?<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h2>

<p>It’s crucial to consult with professional mechanics or auto body experts who can thoroughly inspect the vehicle before making a decision. Their expertise will help uncover any underlying issues that could affect the safety of the car in the long run.</p>

They offer fair and competitive cash prices based on factors such as make, model, year, and overall market demand.</p>
<p>Additionally, opting to sell your damaged car to a cash for car buyer means you don’t have to worry about costly repairs or ongoing maintenance expenses. These buyers typically provide free removal services, allowing you to get rid of your unwanted vehicle hassle-free.</p>
<h2><span class="ez-toc-section" id="conclusion"></span>Conclusion<span class="ez-toc-section-end"></span></h2>
